newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat slips in harvest trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat slips in harvest trade.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat slipped in heavy volume cash market trade midsession at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices pressured by bountiful harvest supply, traders said.

The price paid to wheat farmers in Bahia Blanca lost $2 to $134. April maize firmed $1 to $99 in good volume, with concern over possible quality problems caused by Rio Cuarto disease. May soybeans slipped $1 to $249 in middling turnover, with prices undermined by good crop progress and improving conditions in Brazil. But March sunflower seed gained $2 to $217 in moderate volume, on concern that too much rain might cause fungus.
